# Third-party notices

## fontTools

The Font Replacer uses fontTools for optional font subsetting. fontTools is licensed under the MIT License. See `fontTools-LICENSE.txt`.

## Godot Engine

Godot Engine 4.6.2 is downloaded separately from the official Godot release when required. It is not bundled in this repository.

## GDRE Tools

GDRE Tools is an external utility used for original portrait export and optional validation. It is not bundled in this repository.

## Microsoft DirectXTex / texconv

texconv may be installed separately when DXT5/BC3 encoding is required. It is not bundled in this repository.
